Select the ChEMBL identifier and canonical SMILES for compounds tested in human assays against the target CHEMBL2146312. Join molecule_dictionary to activities, then to assays, then to target_dictionary. Filter by target chembl_id CHEMBL2146312 and assay organism Homo sapiens. Join compound_structures as an INNER JOIN to require canonical SMILES. Alias the molecule identifier as compound_chembl_id. Return compound_chembl_id and canonical_smiles. Sort by compound_chembl_id.
